 Pima County Transportation completes Esperero Wash project
 Pima County Transportation completes Esperero Wash project 
 Title Pima County Transportation completes Esperero Wash project Date Thu, Sep 24, 2026 Description Sunrise Drive is ready for next year’s monsoon. 
 The Pima County Transportation Department recently completed a project designed to make the busy Catalina Foothills road safer during the rainy season.  Pima County Transportation has replaced the culverts under Sunrise Drive, making the busy road safer during the rainy season. 
 The project entailed replacing the old metal culverts that provided drainage for the wash under Sunrise Drive with six concrete box culverts. 
 Josh Orth, capital improvement projects manager at Pima County Project Design & Construction , said that the project resolved an ongoing problem that originated with the 2020 Bighorn Fire. 
 The fire changed runoff patterns in the Catalina Foothills and made the area more vulnerable to flooding. Thanks to increased sediment at the Esperero Wash crossing on Sunrise Drive, stormwater and debris would often flow into the road, creating a hazard for drivers and a maintenance challenge for the County. It also caused the pavement to deteriorate. 
 “This project fixed these issues by increasing the size of the culvert under Sunrise Drive, allowing for a greater flow and less water ponding on the North side of the roadway,” Orth said. 
 Funding for the project was provided by the Arizona Department of Forestry and Fire Management, as part of an ongoing effort to improve local infrastructure and help mitigate increased flood risk downstream of recent large fires. 
 Transportation also repaved Sunrise Drive between Kolb Road and Sabino Canyon Road as part of their ongoing Road Pavement Repair and Preservation Program , a 10-year program to repair and preserve roads within the County’s jurisdiction.
